How It Works

How Bulk WhatsApp works in Kenya

From registration to live delivery, here is what working with MobiWave looks like.

  1. 1

    Create your WhatsApp Business profile

    MobiWave sets up your WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) and verifies your business with Meta — including display name and the green verification tick where eligible.

  2. 2

    Register and verify your number

    We connect your business phone number to the API, complete the Meta verification handshake, and confirm it is ready to send.

  3. 3

    Submit message templates

    Outbound messages outside a 24-hour window must use Meta-approved templates. We help you draft and submit them (marketing, utility, authentication) for approval.

  4. 4

    Collect opt-ins

    Capture WhatsApp opt-in from your website, checkout, USSD or SMS so every conversation is consented and ODPC-aligned. We keep the opt-in ledger for you.

  5. 5

    Send and automate

    Trigger templates via API or dashboard, automate replies with quick-reply menus, and let webhooks route inbound messages to your CRM or support desk.

  6. 6

    Measure and bundle

    Track delivery, reads and drop-off in the analytics dashboard, and connect WhatsApp to SMS, USSD and M-Pesa on the same MobiWave account and billing line.
